behavior.laps.note:
InputError: detect_laps(method='auto') counts laps around a loop, but this environment has no loop: its track graph has no cycle, or its area has no hole to run around.
Why: on a track, a tree maze or in an open arena the animal can always come back the way it went, so no lap goes round a loop and the laps found would have direction 'unknown'.
Fix: for back-and-forth runs on a linear track or arm, use detect_trials(env, times, positions, regions=[start, end]); to segment round trips against a template, pass method='reference' with reference_lap=, which reports each round trip's direction along the track as 'increasing' or 'decreasing'.
